THIS AGENDA HAS BEEN AMENDED TO INCLUDE THE FOLLOWING NOTICE:

This meeting is being held pursuant to Executive Order N-25-20 issued by California Governor
Gavin Newsom on March 12, 2020 to further the State’s efforts to control the spread of COVID-19
Coronavirus. Any and all council members may attend and participate by teleconference/virtual
meeting. Members of the public may also attend by teleconference in order to observe and provide
public comment during the meeting. The meeting will not be livestreamed. If you wish to participate

The public can also email comments on the agenda item to cityclerks@pvestates.org.

Public comments shall be limited to 250 words. Any public comments sent before 6:30 pm to this

Agenda reports and other disclosable public documents relating to each Agenda Item are available
on the City’s website under City Council Meeting Agendas at www.pvestates.org.

  INVESTMENT POLICY ADVISORY COMMITTEE
  OF THE CITY OF PALOS VERDES ESTATES, CALIFORNIA

 Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate
 alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities
 Act. Please contact the City Clerk at 310-378-0383, at least 48 hours prior to the meeting to request
 a disability-related modification or accommodation.

 The Investment Policy Advisory Committee welcomes and encourages public participation at the
 Investment Policy Advisory Committee meetings; however, to allow for the orderly progression of
 business, each person wishing to comment or make a presentation shall be limited to three (3)
 minutes or as specified by the Chairperson. Anyone wishing to address the Investment Policy
 Advisory Committee is requested to fill out a speaker’s card available at the end of each row in the
 Chambers. The card permits the City to identify persons for purposes of Investment Policy
 Advisory Committee minute preparation.

 The Investment Policy Advisory Committee, at the direction of the Chairman with concurrence of
 the Committee, may modify the order of items shown on the agenda.
